_about: Variant of the ALLOWED case in which synth_platform is declared as a consumer rather than a module, so the library synth_impl now depends on a target that is not a module at all. A library must not depend on an application, UI or test target: that inverts the layering, and the plain forbidden-edge rule cannot say so because it only compares modules against modules. The baselined edge is dropped so the rule is reached instead of the ledger. Expected: MODULE-DEPENDS-ON-NON-MODULE.

synth_config._note: Qt6::Qml is allowed -- Qml is not Quick, and core runs profile scripts through QJSEngine. Qt6::Network is listed only because Qt6::Qml re-exports it.

synth_platform._note: Deliberately mis-declared: a consumer, not a module.
